title: Establishing an Optimal Metal–Support Interaction Regime in Cu/In2O3 Catalysts for Stable CO2 Hydrogenation to Methanol

records.entry_label: SI Table S4, This Work row
records.preparation: Catalyst was reduced under H2 flow (20 mL min−1) at 240 °C for 1 h prior to reaction.
records.feed_composition: CO2/H2 reactant mixture with a molar ratio of 1:4; total reactant flow rate 50 mL min−1, corresponding to 10 mL min−1 CO2 and 40 mL min−1 H2
records.notes: Although SI Table S4 is a literature-comparison table, only the row marked 'This Work' was extracted. Selectivity basis follows the SI equations defining SCH3OH = n(CH3OH)out/[n(CO)out + n(CH3OH)out] × 100% in SI Catalytic activity test, page 7. General reaction-test conditions from SI Catalytic activity test, page 6: 0.2 g catalyst diluted with 0.4 g SiO2, 5 MPa, total flow 50 mL min−1, GHSV 15,000 cm3 h−1 gcat−1, and 30 min stabilization at each reaction temperature.

extraction_notes: SI Figure S9 reports a time-on-stream stability test of Cu/In2O3-CP at 300 °C with dense plotted points for CO2 conversion, CH3OH selectivity, and CH3OH STY. No exact numerical values are printed, and the plotted markers are too dense to extract every distinct time-on-stream point reliably; therefore it was not converted into records. Characterisation tables/figures and DFT data were excluded.
